authoring: Whole new generated WORLD figures reduced once to native32, then semantic per8x8 hardware-palette conversion. The two lower-leg walking keys per direction are deliberately authored native cell changes. No16px enlargement or recovered source grid is claimed.
baseline_unchanged: Approved Boar/Kolkar, original source PNGs, earlier releases and24px actor packets are untouched. Root integrates separate mixed-size32 renderer.

troll_villager.identity: Blue troll traveller/villager in an ivory tunic, red crest, long hooked nose and ivory tusks, leather strap and side satchel. Explicitly reuses the generated merchant family; not a sixth independent source.
troll_villager.animation_note: Two authored alternating ankle/toe lifts in each true direction, not global bobbing; head/hair and all pixels above row27 are fixed. Staves outside explicit foot regions remain fixed.

provenance.transparency: Idle alpha equals literal source alpha≥128 sampled by nearest; native gait alpha changes only within its explicit lower-foot region.
provenance.conversion: Lossy whole-body nearest32 fit; exact source geometry before reduction, no added outline or erasure for OAM; per-tile semantic palette fit preserves blue skin, pale tusks/eyes, red crest, warm leather and purple cloth when the8x8 budget permits.
